strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
I'd like them back soon, but...
But Commander, isn't it a little sad for them? Ninjas are long gone...
Ninjas... I've only ever seen them in manga and novels.
Are there really no ninjas left, I wonder?
If they still exist somewhere, I'd love to see one.
Yeah, if there are ninjas, I'd like to fight one. Right, Domon?
(...Ridiculous. This is no time to be looking for ninjas...
Besides, I'm worried about where Master went...)
A ninja legend, huh... How many centuries back is that?
Those guys who ride frogs and vanish in a puff of smoke, right?
Koji, you're just making that up, aren't you?
So what? Anyway, that pretty princess and her attendant
being aliens sounds fishy too, right? Oh, and the big guy.
What about Daisuke and Maria? They're from Fleed, aren't they?
...Now that you mention it.
Ninjas...? Why would aliens from a star system 60,000 light-years away
know about ninjas, who only existed in one island nation on Earth,
and come looking for them?
And that princess looks like an Earthling any way you slice it.
Did she really come from the Shema system?
Jun, Daisuke and Maria are from planet Fleed, remember?
...Oh, that's right.
Raideen was supposedly built 12,000 years ago on the continent of Mu.
At this point, time and distance don't really matter anymore.
Maybe Japan really does hold something mystical, Mister.
How carefree.
There's nothing here, so shouldn't we hurry on ahead...?
But... it bugs me.
What came of that report of a huge energy reading around here?
Too many sudden attacks lately... We shouldn't let our guard down.
...There you have it, Princess Romina. Just like the Gandor folks said...
all that's here are sets for tourists.
...No... After coming all this way... Is it hopeless...? Joe...
H-Hey now, Princess Romina... don't look at me like that... Jeez...
...!! Joe! Don't get so close to her!
Lenny, this is no time to worry about that!
What do we do, Big Bro? We've lost our goal!
Yeah, well...
Looks like... that's how it is.
Commander, seems our business here is done.
...I see. I'm sorry we couldn't be of help...
Maya, Ai, Coil... return to the Gandor.
...Well, can't be helped... Hmm!? Hey, Commander! Trouble!
What's wrong? Damian...?
Too late!
They were hiding underground!?
Damn, Princess Romina! Get back to the Elshank!
Ah... Joe!
Princess!
We won't make it...! Princess Romina, it's cramped, but get in Kurojishi!
Hurry, Princess!
Mike, Lenny!
We're ready for battle over here, Big Bro!
Joe! You'd better not have tried anything funny with Princess Romina!
Idiot! Is this the time!?
...They say they don't know about ninjas, but...
between those Za Boom guys and that mysterious robot Tobikage...
there are just too many similarities to ninjas...
Ngh, we can't leave them behind...! All hands, launch!
Joe...! I've finally found you!
Ilbora!? You...!
Lord Ilbora!
Who's that? Someone you know?
Ilbora Saro. He betrayed us and went over to the enemy!
So he's the same kind of bastard as Gil Berg, huh.
Then... he's gonna be persistent.
...Though really, we're the ones who drove him out...
Just like... him. He lost his place to belong...?
Lord Ilbora is no traitor!
If only you hadn't come! ...Lord Ilbora would...
Joe! To defeat you, I sold my warrior's soul to Za Boom...!
Now, face me!
...Ilbora!
Wha...! It can't be... Princess!? Is that you, Princess Romina...!?
Why? Why did you... have to leave us...!?
Princess Romina...!
Ilbora... answer me.
Why would you, my guard captain and commander of the Elshank...
...Princess Romina... I'm sorry... All units... commence attack...!
Ilbora!
A high-energy reading!? From what direction!?
Tobikage!
Here it comes! Damn, I wanna make an entrance like that too!
Koji... that's just your thing, huh.
That robot again...!? Who on earth is piloting it!?
At least it's on our side!
So that's... Tobikage! Bah, crush it!
I hate relying on you, but... I'm counting on you, Tobikage!
No... the Skeleton!? Ngh, blast it, Joe! We'll settle this later!
Wait! Ilbora!
Joe! Please wait. Please... don't go after him...
Princess Romina...
Lord Ilbora... I wanted to go with you...
...Commander Hazuki... let us go on to the next site...
Are you sure, Princess Romina? What about the ninja...
I haven't given up yet...
But we too will stand with you in this fight to the very end...
Princess...
Joe, what do we do...?
...No choice, right? We'll tag along...!
That aside, something's odd...
What is, Hayato?
How did the Za Boom army get all the way down here?
How did they reach the surface... without Londo Bell noticing...
The huge energy reading detected here...
might have something to do with it.
